title: When set simultaneously, Max-Age takes precedence over Expires.
summary: When the browser supports these two properties, the relative lifetime Max-Age takes precedence over the absolute time Expires.
applies: Browser interpretation of URLs, cookies, and origins
detail: Max-Age=0 and Expires is in the future tense. It cannot be judged based on the latter that the cookie must be retained.
boundary: Whether to replace existing records also depends on matching criteria such as name, domain, and path.
relevance: How to interpret conflicting expiration prompts when rebuilding session timelines.
